faqs.question: Can 1st year and 2nd year college students join the cohorts?
faqs.answer: Yes! In fact, over 65% of our learners join during their 1st or 2nd year. Starting early allows you to build a standout portfolio of capstone projects, gain confidence in group discussions, and secure competitive summer internships before your final placement year.

faqs.question: How do the guaranteed internship and referral drives work?
faqs.answer: Students who maintain 80%+ attendance and successfully submit their capstone projects become eligible for Youthinity's internal placement drives. We partner directly with 500+ corporate hiring managers, startups, and marketing agencies across India who interview our certified cohort graduates.

faqs.question: What are the live class timings? Will it clash with college exams?
faqs.answer: All cohort live sessions are scheduled on weekday evenings (after 7:00 PM IST) or weekend afternoons. Furthermore, during peak university exam months (such as semester end exams), cohorts offer exam pauses and permanent access to all HD recordings and mentor notes.

faqs.question: Do I receive verified certificates upon completion?
faqs.answer: Yes. Every graduate receives an official, verifiable Certificate of Apprenticeship with a unique credential ID and QR code, directly verifiable on LinkedIn and by corporate background screening partners.

faqs.question: What is the difference between free masterclasses and flagship cohorts?
faqs.answer: Free masterclasses are 90-minute standalone webinars offering broad perspective on industry topics. Flagship cohorts are intensive 6-to-12 week structured programs with 1-on-1 mentorship, live assignment reviews, capstone projects, placement support, and peer pods.
